title: BAYESIAN EVALUATION OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL BEHAVIOR
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The case studies focus on 1) pairwise preferences between LLM responses on general topics, and 2) refusal rates for harmful, non-religious prompts (e.g., instructions for hacking).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
